source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The early-tagging port selects the shared lando worker and declares one buildN tag action in the promote phase. It does not add the release-version-bump kind version-update action. Try selects staging repositories by release type. Accepted source later supplies an explicit revision through task context and updates repository/ESR names. Declared actions and phase do not establish a successful remote tag.
title: Early Lando tagging stays a promote-phase buildN action
